accom_shared_hostel_dorm.sourceTitle: San Francisco Average Hostel Prices | Budget Your Trip
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.evidenceText: The average price for a dorm bed in a hostel in San Francisco (based on data from 15 hostels with dorms) is an affordable $33.
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip hostel-price analysis; result crawled last week before 2026-07-31; prices before taxes and fees
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com San Francisco United States hostel private room average nightly price
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.reason: The exact San Francisco Budget Your Trip page gives a numeric city-level average for a dorm bed, with a 15-hostel sample and a one-bed sleeping unit. No two-traveller scaling or currency conversion was performed. The same page's private-room figure was not used because two-adult occupancy is not explicit.

accom_hostel_private_room.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com San Francisco United States hostel private room average nightly price
accom_hostel_private_room.reason: Budget Your Trip exposed an exact San Francisco private-room average of $36 based on 24 hostels and guesthouses, while an independent Hostelz result exposed $84 under a female-only filter; neither result explicitly establishes two-adult/two-guest occupancy and the filtered result is not a general city basket. The strict private-room contract therefore fails closed.
